source.quote: SMSL's own page for the VMV D2R MK2, read 2026-11-24: « ROHM BD34302EKV decoding chip and the cutting-edge XMOS XU-316 solution, unlocking native DSD512, PCM up to 768kHz, and full MQA/MQA-C[D] ».

facts.chip: ROHM BD34302EKV converting, XMOS XU-316 as the USB interface. Note the part number against smsl/d200's BD34352EKV: two ROHM parts, one family, two models.

_only_usb_rated: The sentence read ties its figures to the XMOS solution, which is USB. No other input is rated, so none is recorded.
